semantic_mapping.semantic_assessment: Candidate root must be an unlinked directory with exactly release.json and the exact platform binary. Manifest is bounded duplicate-free JSON with exact five fields and compatible advertised versions; platform entry is exact and native_tested is literal True, filename/digest exact. Leaf symlink/reparse/nonregular/oversize inputs and changed bytes throw; this does not assert all ancestor links are rejected.
